answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identity via a cryptographic stake burning mechanism. Each node must anchor its identity by burning tokens to create a verifiable proof-of-burn, where costs scale superlinearly as O(N^2) for N identities. Sybil swarms branch out like an entangled vine of fake identities, but the cumulative burn requirement rises steeply toward an economic summit, rendering mass clone creation exponentially unprofitable.
